title: What's New: Open Sourcing Power BI Apps for Business Central (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to open-sourced Power BI apps
How to download and modify Power BI apps

features.name: Open-sourced Power BI apps for Business Central
features.description: Power BI applications for Business Central are now open-sourced, allowing users to download source code and modify semantic models and reports.

features.name: Wave 1 Power BI apps open sourcing
features.description: Most Power BI apps were open-sourced in release wave 1, providing high quality semantic models and designed reports out of the box.

features.name: Wave 2 Power BI apps for sales, purchasing, and projects
features.description: Three remaining Power BI apps for sales, purchasing, and projects are being released in wave 2, completing the open-source availability.
caveats: download option available in October versions

features.name: Download Power BI app source code via PBX file
features.description: Users can download the PBX file from Power BI service using File menu to access the source code for Power BI apps.
caveats: download option only available in new versions published in October for sales, purchasing, projects

features.name: Power BI app documentation including DAX expressions
features.description: Each Power BI app has documentation covering both reports and semantic models, including how measures are calculated and their DAX expressions.

quotes.text: In release wave 1, we open sourced most of the apps.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the timeline and scope of the first wave of open-sourcing Power BI apps for Business Central.

quotes.text: Remaining three is coming now here in wave two, which is uh sales, the apps for sales, for purchasing and for projects.
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies which apps are being released in wave 2 and completes the open-source availability across all major modules.

quotes.text: Everything is now uh available by the time of this recording. Uh all the source code uh you can download.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms general availability of all Power BI app source code for download at the time of the video.

quotes.text: For sales, purchasing and for projects, the download this file option only will only be present in the new versions we are publishing here
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates a specific timeline constraint - the download feature is only available in October versions for these three apps.

quotes.text: each of the PowerBI apps have their own part of the documentation where both the reports are documented as well as the semantic model.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the comprehensive documentation available for understanding and modifying the Power BI apps.
